Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (July 27, 2023) from the Chief Procurement Officer: Solicitation Number: Request for Tender, Ariba Document Number 3941039502 Description: For the supply of all labour, equipment and material necessary for the state of good repair and Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act Upgrades at The Assembly Hall, 1 Colonel Samuel Smith Park Drive. Recommended Supplier: Brook Restoration Ltd.
